title.en: Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption — Sin Chew Jit Poh (Singapore) Limited) Notification

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption — Sin Chew Jit Poh (Singapore) Limited) Notification.

heading.en: Exemption of Sin Chew Jit Poh (Singapore) Limited

text.en: 2. Until further notice, the Sin Chew Jit Poh (Singapore) Limited is exempted from section 9(3) and (5) of the Act so long as the number of management shares issued before the 11th October 1977 by the company does not fall below 41,500 shares.
